description: Community Road Safety Grants is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. The Department of Transport and Main Roads offers funding to community groups for community projects and programs that work to address road safety issues in support of the strategic objectives set out within the Queensland Road Safety Strategy 2015-2021 and associated Action Plan. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are TMR, community, grants, road safety. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, txt. The portal shows 2022-06-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
